integrity: New count and structural classification derived by proof and accompanied by exhaustive finite cross-checks. Prior equal-run all-length result covers the diagonal subcase, not the four-variable assertion. Neither independent review nor independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: For binary inputs 0^a1^b and 1^c0^d with each exponent at least two, only longest subsequence-minimal common supersequences are classified. Singleton-run inputs are excluded; no claim about shorter MCS lengths. The full 1996 journal paper and another 1995 specialized paper were not accessible in full and could contain overlapping results.
title: Extremal minimal supersequences of unequal opposite binary blocks
